title: Synthetic 12-month default experiment
disclaimer: Entirely fictional data. Results demonstrate simulator assumptions, not validated lending performance. Demo scenarios are a separate dataset.

configuration.calibration: Logistic sigmoid on clipped probability logits; fit only on calibration split

generating_process.formula: P(default)=sigmoid(intercept + 1.1*financial_stress + network_strength*mean(guaranteed borrowers' observed financial_stress) + hidden_group_shock)
generating_process.intercept: Solved per seed and condition to set mean simulated probability to 0.08; realized prevalence varies
generating_process.hidden_group_shock: One independent Normal(0,0.35) draw per relationship group; excluded from predictors
generating_process.graph: Each disconnected group is a directed guarantee ring with an additional outgoing chord with probability0.35 per borrower. Balances are LogNormal(10,0.7). All graph features precede outcomes.
generating_process.limitations: Edges are generated randomly; this is neither causal identification nor an estimate of real default risk. Absent network effects is a negative control. Temporal generalization is not tested by the group split.

provenance.uncertainty: 95% percentile intervals from held-out whole-group resampling within each seed. Summary intervals average independent per-seed bootstrap draws; conditional on the five fitted runs, not population or between-training-run uncertainty.
provenance.uplift: Paired graph-enriched minus borrower-only LightGBM on identical held-out group resamples; positive improves AP/AUC, negative improves Brier/log loss.
